scientific_integrity: The original five-tap filter, its critical spectral peaks and local-limit attractors are credited to prior literature. The claimed addition is the sharp moving-parameter BV norm boundary layer. Finite checker calculations do not establish the infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Real bilateral integer-lattice signals of finite first-difference variation, unweighted five-tap convolution, integer powers, compact moving-parameter ranges; not finite boundaries or nonuniform grids. Same-model scientific review only; historical-priority uncertainty remains in signed-convolution stability literature.
title: A sharp two-scale variation boundary layer for iterated five-point biharmonic smoothing
